Bluestein R H & Company Cut Position in Facebook Cl A (FB) by $1.69 Million as Market Value Declined; United Contl Hldgs (UAL) Valuation Rose While Cyrus Capital Partners LP Has Raised Stake
May 19, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Bluestein R H & Company decreased its stake in Facebook Inc Cl A (FB) by 2.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bluestein R H & Company sold 9,577 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund held 344,098 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $60.72M, down from 353,675 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bluestein R H & Company who had been investing in Facebook Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $528.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $1.08 during the last trading session, reaching $182.68. About 10.38 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Stephen C. Freidheim increased its stake in United Contl Hldgs Inc (UAL) by 18.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cyrus Capital Partners Lp bought 487,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.38% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Stephen C. Freidheim held 3.13M shares of the transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $211.21 million, up from 2.65M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cyrus Capital Partners Lp who had been investing in United Contl Hldgs Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $18.97 billion market cap company. (NYSE:UAL) has declined 0.28% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.83% the S&P500.
